versos.texto_bv: Diante dele ia a peste, e a labareda saía aos seus pés.
versos.traducao_literal: Diante dele, ia a peste; e saía a labareda aos seus pés.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): A BV traduz a segunda imagem do verso ('labareda') como chama, enquanto as três referências convergem em 'peste/doença' para o mesmo termo hebraico ambíguo (רֶשֶׁף, resheph). — evidência: NTLH: 'atrás vêm doenças mortais'; ARA: 'por detrás a praga ardente'; NVIPT: 'doenças terríveis seguiam os seus passos' — nenhuma referência preserva a imagem de fogo/chama presente na BV.

kjv.texto: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

vizinhos.4: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
vizinhos.6: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.

web.texto: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

vizinhos.4: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
vizinhos.6: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

versos.texto_bv: O teu arco se descobre por completo; os juramentos feitos às tribos são a tua palavra. Selá. Fendes a terra com rios.
versos.traducao_literal: Nudez, descobre-se o teu arco; juramentos das tribos, a palavra. Selá. Rios, fendes a terra.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): A BV traduz a cláusula obscura do hebraico (שְׁבֻעוֹת מַטּוֹת אֹמֶר) como 'os juramentos feitos às tribos são a tua palavra', enquanto as três referências interpretam o mesmo trecho como relativo a flechas/aljava. — evidência: NTLH: '...te preparas para atirar as tuas flechas'; ARA: 'a tua aljava está cheia de flechas'; NVIPT: '...pediste muitas flechas' — as três convergem em 'flechas', divergindo da leitura de 'juramentos' da BV.

kjv.texto: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

vizinhos.8: Was the Lord displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?
vizinhos.10: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.

web.texto: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

vizinhos.8: Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?
vizinhos.10: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
